How we know

Tripower’s home page lists the Saturday rides at 7:15 am and 8:30 am from Conte’s Bike Shop, 1805 Laskin Rd, and shows the club’s Oct 10, 2026 Pink Ride as upcoming (page fetched Oct 1, 2026). Conte’s Southern Virginia calendar lists the same ride.

For visitors

Two start times on the club page: 7:15 am and 8:30 am. The distance runs from 20 to 55 miles depending on the start and the loops you add.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:15 am. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
The easiest pace the host lists is 16–18 mph: brisk — you’ll want some fitness. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @tripowercycling the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Saturday Group Ride (Tripower Cycling Club) group ride

Saturday Group Ride (Tripower Cycling Club) is a road group ride in Virginia Beach, VA. It rolls every Saturday at 7:15 am from Conte’s Bike Shop Virginia Beach.

A Saturday road ride in two pace groups: A at 22-25 mph (drop) and B at 18-20 mph (no-drop) per the shop calendar. It is two loops of about 20 miles with a regroup at the shop around 8:30, and a third loop makes it about 55 miles. A longer Pungo route of about 60 miles also runs at 7:15 for A+ riders.
